description: DeviationScope::IssuerDnContains requires the substring to be pre-lowercased (invariant enforced only in DeviationStore::add). Direct construction like DeviationScope::IssuerDnContains("Agency X".to_string()).matches(&cert) silently fails. Fix: lowercase in matches() rather than only at construction time — already paying the allocation for cert.tbs_certificate.issuer.to_string(). File: pkix-lint/src/deviation.rs lines 238-242, 306-319.
title: pkix-lint: IssuerDnContains silent no-match when constructed directly
